chapters.reason: The paper introduces RASC, which enhances Self-Consistency by dynamically evaluating multiple reasoning paths and using early stopping and weighted majority voting, directly aligning with parallel search's focus on generating and evaluating multiple candidates concurrently.

RASC dynamically scales compute during inference via parallel sampling (search width) and early stopping decisions, focusing on test-time efficiency and balancing search depth/width, which matches the description of efficient test-time scaling and infinity thinking.

The paper addresses hallucination mitigation and improves reasoning faithfulness by selecting high-fidelity rationales, targeting the intersection of efficiency and trustworthy reasoning to reduce unreliable outputs in long reasoning chains.
